trigger.actualFailure: Runtime Agent registration reaches the corrected 19/19 INSERT and MariaDB rejects null OPS_SERVICE_INSTANCE.base_url

rootCause: CpfRuntimeControlAgentAutoConfiguration treats cpf.runtime.control.agent.runtime-base-url as optional but supplies no derived default, while the canonical OPS_SERVICE_INSTANCE base_url column is mandatory and the smoke uses a standard server.port without the optional override.
requiredFix: Preserve explicit operator URL, otherwise derive a valid http(s) URL from server address/runtime hostname and effective configured port, with wildcard/IPv6 handling and focused tests.
prohibitedWorkarounds: Do not make canonical base_url nullable
Do not inject a smoke-only URL
Do not disable Runtime Agent registration
